method: Two model reviewers each inspected a disjoint half; not human or independent dual review. Criteria included contextual completeness, translation quality, potential factual and time-sensitive risks.
limitations: Each sample is one selected span per page; it is not uniform over spans.
Review strictness and passage length differ from P222, so pass proportions cannot be directly compared.
Uncertain includes potentially useful text requiring additional context or verification; it is not a claim of falsehood.
Neither approval nor legal or factual verification is implied.
